about: CCSP-aligned coverage of this estate. Sub-topic titles and domain weights are from ISC2's published CCSP exam outline; the status and evidence are OUR assessment of what the estate demonstrates in practice. It is not ISC2 content, not study material, and not a prediction of an exam result.

source.caveat: The page shows AUGUST 1, 2026 above the outline title but does not state what that date means; third-party sources say the new outline took effect on that date. Verify on ISC2's site.

status_values.covered: implemented AND proven by a journey or test (never docs alone)
status_values.partial: designed or partly proven (reason in the note)

topics.title: Understand cloud computing concepts
topics.note: Three-cloud IaC (AWS/GCP/Azure), managed Kubernetes stages, shared-responsibility reasoning in docs. Never applied to a real cloud account.

topics.title: Describe cloud reference architecture
topics.note: Layered ladder (seed → sprout → burrow → tree → canopy → forest) and a reference architecture for the AI estate; documented, validated offline.

topics.title: Understand security concepts relevant to cloud computing
topics.note: Zero-trust network policy, per-tenant keys, least privilege, security invariants proven on offline Terraform plans (no public buckets, encryption on, no open ingress). Not applied to a live account.

topics.title: Understand design principles of secure cloud computing
topics.note: Dormancy by default, least privilege, defence in depth, fail-closed rails, deny-by-default storage; principles documented and enforced by plan proofs and fitness ratchets.

topics.title: Evaluate Cloud Service Providers (CSP)
topics.note: Side-by-side genomes for AWS/GCP/Azure with cost and capability caveats. No formal CSP due-diligence (SOC 2 / ISO reports, SLAs, residency attestations).

topics.title: Comprehend Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML)
topics.note: The estate IS an AI-security platform: guardrail gateway mapped to OWASP LLM Top 10, ATLAS red team, purple-team loop, AI-SPM, model self-correction, local-model benchmarking.

topics.title: Describe cloud data concepts
topics.note: Data lifecycle handled in the estate (prompts redacted in path, audit logs, backups, vault). Documented, not a full lifecycle model.

topics.title: Design and implement cloud data storage architectures
topics.note: Seed bank: versioned, object-locked, KMS-encrypted bucket; deletion-guarded data disks; deny-by-default storage. Proven on plans only.

topics.title: Design and apply data security technologies and strategies
topics.note: DLP in the request path (India PII: Aadhaar, PAN, cards; secrets), secrets management (OpenBao proven), encryption designed in IaC. Cloud KMS paths untested on a real account.

topics.title: Implement data discovery
topics.note: DSPM-style scan of the repo/estate for AI data exposure. Not a data-store discovery tool.

topics.title: Plan and implement data classification
topics.note: Sensitivity classes recognised in transit (PII types, secrets, canaries). No at-rest labelling scheme.

topics.title: Design and implement Information Rights Management (IRM)
topics.note: Not covered. (Adjacent: owner-only secrets files; object-lock for immutability.)

topics.title: Plan and implement data retention, deletion, and archiving policies
topics.note: Backup retention, object-lock/versioning, audit-log retention target documented (CERT-In 180 days), typed-confirmation prune. No policy engine.

topics.title: Design and implement auditability, traceability, and accountability of data events
topics.note: Every gateway decision is an audit event; the SOC correlates them; the purple loop verifies prevented/logged/alerted end to end and found+fixed an audit-accuracy bug; evidence pack with checksums.

topics.title: Comprehend data protection of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) data
topics.note: Prompt/response PII redaction, local-first model option, no prompts or keys in evidence packs, supply-chain vetting of third-party AI content, model registry governance.

topics.title: Comprehend cloud infrastructure and platform components
topics.note: Real k3s multi-node cluster (twin), IaC for managed Kubernetes, GitOps. Managed-cloud components not run for real.

topics.title: Design a secure data center
topics.note: Not covered (physical/environmental security). Adjacent: home-lab power-loss reflex and UPS hook (untested on a real UPS).

topics.title: Analyze risks associated with cloud infrastructure and platforms
topics.note: Vulnerability scanning (Trivy) prioritised offline with CISA KEV, supply-chain gate, honest limits ledger, fitness ratchets. No formal risk register for cloud-specific risks.

topics.title: Plan and implementation of security controls
topics.note: Compose-level controls tested (loopback binds, owner-only secrets); Kubernetes controls (Kyverno, Falco, NetworkPolicy) rendered and schema-validated, not run on a live cluster.

topics.title: Plan business continuity (BC) and disaster recovery (DR)
topics.note: Verified backup/restore, hibernate/wake with data intact, fallback ladders, a real etcd snapshot-restore drill with SLOs, power-loss reflex.

topics.title: Advocate training and awareness for application security
topics.note: Incident runbook, build contract and learning ledger. No formal awareness programme.

topics.title: Describe the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process
topics.note: Documented build contract and gate loop (tests first, surgical changes, hard rules) plus the CI pipeline; the contract's hard rules are mechanically enforced (diffcheck_gate).

topics.title: Apply the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
topics.note: Applied every change: lint, unit tests, SAST/secrets/container/IaC scans in CI, diffcheck guard on automated changes, ratchets.

topics.title: Apply cloud software assurance and validation
topics.note: User-perspective sandbox (real containers + browser), purple-team loop, red-team scorecard, fitness functions with mutation tests.

topics.title: Use verified secure software
topics.note: Third-party content only via `vet`: pinned commit, licence, executable-surface and injection scan, byte-identical vendoring, tamper detection; upstream organs pinned.

topics.title: Comprehend and apply the specifics of cloud application architecture
topics.note: Policy-enforcement-point gateway in front of a model router, multi-tenant cell design. Documented and tested locally; cloud application patterns untested live.

topics.title: Design appropriate Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
topics.note: Keycloak SSO/MFA proven in the sprout (login, realm survives hibernation); tenant OIDC-group RBAC rendered; per-tenant SSO realm not built.

topics.title: Build and implement physical and logical infrastructure for cloud environment
topics.note: Logical infrastructure as code with proofs; burrow twin builds a real cluster; physical build is yours (spore installers untested on real hardware).

topics.title: Operate and maintain physical and logical infrastructure for cloud environment
topics.note: Self-healing, watchdog with alerting, auto-update, model self-correction, game days for node loss and control-plane restart.

topics.title: Implement operational controls and standards
topics.note: Runbook, GitOps drift correction, CI gates, fitness budgets. No formal change/configuration-management record.

topics.title: Support digital forensics
topics.note: Preservation: etcd snapshots, tamper-evident evidence packs (SHA-256), audit trail without content. No chain-of-custody procedure or forensic tooling.

topics.title: Manage communication with relevant parties
topics.note: Alert webhooks, incident runbook templates, escalation briefs. No stakeholder communication plan.

topics.title: Manage security operations
topics.note: AI-SOC correlation with ATT&CK technique names and offline KEV enrichment, purple-loop detection backlog, SIEM organs defined.

topics.title: Articulate legal requirements and unique risks within the cloud environment
topics.note: India-first control mapping (RBI, CERT-In, DPDP, SEBI) documented; not legal advice.

topics.title: Understand privacy issues
topics.note: DPDP-aware PII redaction and local-first sovereignty. No DPIA or consent tooling.

topics.title: Understand audit process, methodologies, and required adaptations for a cloud environment
topics.note: Auditor-oriented evidence pack and a status/traceability ledger. Not an audited ISMS.

topics.title: Understand implications of cloud to enterprise risk management
topics.note: Board brief generator, AI-SPM posture score, honest limits ledger. No enterprise risk register.

topics.title: Understand outsourcing and cloud contract design
topics.note: Not covered. (Adjacent: portable genomes and vault-first design support exit planning; licence checks for third-party content.)
